mechanism: GA-discovered adversarial garbage schedule: fire probabilities tuned per clear-size bin (~37%/42%/2.5% on the 4-6/7-10/11+ bins) + near_spawn column targeting (columns ranked by distance to the NES spawn columns 3,4). Converged independently in 3 GA search runs (ADVERSARIAL_PRESSURE.md sec1.4). Raises the floor under the spawn lane so the champion increasingly has to choose between clearing a virus and keeping the spawn lane clear late in the game -- it dies DIES_AHEAD, holding viruses, not from raw pile-up. STRUCTURAL-FILTER VERDICT: FLUKE (1/5 perturbation categories survived -- only timing_jitter; neighbouring-seeds/history-shift/column-jitter/size-jitter all failed the CI-separation survival bar). The exact fire/size shape this genome found is overfit to its training/original-holdout seed block, not a general property.
